module_summary: Circular-buffer stream FIFO with wrap-bit read/write pointers, register-array storage and valid/ready handshakes on both sides, allowing same-cycle read/write when full.

anchors.name: data_q
anchors.why: Depth-entry data array written at write pointer, read at read pointer

anchors.name: write_ptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer with wrap bit; selects write slot and drives full detection

anchors.name: read_ptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer with wrap bit; selects output entry and drives empty detection

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Input push valid; with ready_o triggers write and pointer increment

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Not-full indication from pointer comparison, accepts input pushes

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Not-empty indication from pointer comparison, offers head data

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream pop request; with valid_o advances read pointer

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Pushed data written into storage at write pointer slot

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Head-of-FIFO data read from storage at read pointer

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush command clearing both pointers and deasserting handshakes

anchors.name: load_data
anchors.why: Storage load enable asserted on accepted push

groups.name: FIFO storage
groups.description: Register array holding Depth entries, loaded on accepted pushes

groups.name: Pointer and flag logic
groups.description: Wrap-bit pointers compute full/empty, advance on handshakes, cleared by flush

groups.name: Push interface
groups.description: Input stream valid and data accepted when ready_o high

groups.name: Pop interface
groups.description: Output stream head data popped when ready_i and valid_o
